name: @workspace/extension
description: StudentHub registry scraper - extracts course offerings and exports registry-ready JSON

scripts.build: wxt build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const s=p.join('.output','chrome-mv3');const d=p.join('.output','extention');if(fs.existsSync(s)){fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(d),{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('copied chrome-mv3 -> extention')}"
